why: Woodall's conjecture itself (unweighted, general digraphs) is reported as still open across all sources checked. A 2025 paper by Cornuejols, Liu, and Ravi ('A Min-Max Relation on Dicuts and Dijoins in Weighted Chordal Digraphs', arXiv:2501.10918) proves a min-max relation for chordal digraphs, which may be a restricted case of Woodall's conjecture (or of the related weighted Edmonds-Giles version) settled for that class, but it is unclear from search snippets alone whether this is the unweighted Woodall statement restricted to chordal digraphs or the separate weighted Edmonds-Giles conjecture restricted to chordal digraphs.
queries: Woodall's conjecture dicut dijoin proof disproved
Woodall conjecture counterexample disjoint dijoins minimum dicut
